title: Private install prereq linter & mitigation runner
creator: Samantha Cruz
description: Create an automated 'preflight linter' that runs against customer Terraform/IaC and the target cloud account to detect and classify pre-install issues for Private (VPC) deployments. The runner should: (1) detect quota shortfalls (cores, GPUs, regional SKUs), (2) validate IAM roles/policies and required service principals, (3) verify DNS zone ownership and recommended TTL settings, (4) confirm network constraints (subnet sizes, MTU, NAT/GW availability), and (5) produce actionable mitigation suggestions and one-click remediation where safe. Output is a structured report and a set of remediation terraform snippets or admin runbook steps.
comments: 2026-03-01 - Samantha Cruz: Initial ticket created after on-call incident where a customer install failed due to regional GPU SKU shortage. Captured scope and primary failure modes.

2026-03-03 - Ravi Patel: Spike complete — implemented a prototype that hits AWS and GCP quota APIs and parses terraform provider blocks. Proof-of-concept can surface quotas and map terraform resource addresses to required quotas. Pushed branch feat/preflight-runner-spike.

2026-03-04 - Elena Morris (PM): Feedback from product review: report must clearly separate 'blocking' vs 'recommended' findings and include exact terraform code snippets for common fixes (eg. increase instance limit, switch GPU SKU). Add a short lived 'apply' helper only for org-admins.

2026-03-06 - Ravi Patel: Design decision: runner will run in two modes — 'read-only audit' (default) and 'assisted remediation' (opt-in; requires admin OAuth and explicit consent). Assisted remediation will output terraform HCL snippets and an optional PR template, not auto-apply. Chosen to reduce blast radius and simplify security review.
